description: Use when an agent needs the full detail of a single market by its composite key (source + market_id). Returns the market with its parent event reference, current probability, volume, 24h delta, and historical chart points. Includes a `_meta.cite_as` field that the agent can drop directly into its reply. Markets are removed from the live tables 10 days after their event closes; the same URL then returns a `kind: "tombstone"` object with the market's final record: the result where known, the last price pdata recorded and since when, the last bid and ask, lifetime volume and close time, instead of the live `kind: "live"` object. Check `kind` before reading any other field. Records exist for markets removed since late November 2026; an older id is a 404, though its event's own record (`get_event`) may list it among its top 10 markets.

market_id.description: Market ID native to the source. Composite key with `source`.
market_id.title: Market Id

source.description: Platform ID: polymarket / kalshi / manifold / myriad / limitless / predict / opinion / gemini / hyperliquid / mnx / seer / xo.
